sections.changelog:
Added

  • Weighted relevance scoring across six factors: shared categories, tags, custom taxonomy terms, title words, content words, freshness.
  • Russian stemmer for text similarity, ported from MVweb Smart Links.
  • Own index tables (`mvweb_rp_tokens`, `mvweb_rp_index`) with background WP Cron indexing, dirty queue and a transient lock.
  • Settings page in MVweb Hub with General, Algorithm, Design, Index and Help tabs on Admin UI Kit v2.
  • Three weight presets plus per-factor sliders with an editable number field.
  • Editor metabox: pinned posts, exclusions, per-post block toggle, "never suggest" flag and score debugging.
  • Output as automatic after-content block, `[mvweb_related_posts]` shortcode, `mvweb_rp_related()` / `mvweb_rp_get_related()` PHP functions and a sidebar widget.
  • Three overridable templates: cards grid, list with thumbnail, plain links.
  • Image cascade (featured image → first content image → bundled placeholder), own `mvweb_rp_thumb` size, CSS aspect-ratio cropping, lazy loading.
  • Bundled neutral SVG placeholder for cards without an image.
  • Asset versioning by `filemtime()`, so an updated stylesheet or script busts the browser cache immediately.
  • Optional JSON-LD `ItemList` markup.
  • Rendered block cache: object cache with transient fallback, versioned invalidation.
  • Guard against a duplicate block when MVweb Smart Links renders its own.
  • English and Russian translations.
